# Aevo

> Aevo is a UAE-based peptide research brand offering verified peptide formats — pens, vials and nasal sprays — with same-day Dubai delivery.

Aevo curates a considered range of research peptides grouped by goal: weight loss, recovery, energy & longevity, brain performance and hormone optimization. Products are the official Apex Pharma line, third-party verified.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Brand overview and full range
- [Science](/science): Verification, cold-chain handling and lab standards
- [Shipping & Returns](/shipping): UAE delivery rates and returns policy

## Collections
- [Weight Loss](/collection/weight-loss): Retatrutide, Tirzepatide, AOD-9604 and more
- [Recovery](/collection/recovery): BPC-157, TB-500, KPV, DSIP
- [Energy & Longevity](/collection/energy-longevity): NAD+, MOTS-C, Epitalon, GHK-Cu
- [Brain Performance](/collection/brain-performance): Semax, Selank, PT-141, Kisspeptin
- [Hormone Optimization](/collection/hormone-optimization): Ipamorelin, Sermorelin, CJC-1295, Somatropin
